latent.tooltip: Video-only latent to condition. Must be a 5D video latent (batch, channels, frames, height, width).

frame_idx.tooltip:
RoPE position of the reference, in pixel frames.
0 aligns the reference with the generated clip. Use for video references.
>0 places the reference at a specific pixel-frame position in the clip.
-1 places the reference outside the generated frame range, while still using it for attention conditioning. Use for single-image references.
For multi-frame references, >0 values are rounded down to 1 mod 8.

latent_downscale_factor.tooltip: For IC-LoRA on small grid. 1 means original size, 2 means half size, 3 means third, etc.

crop.tooltip: Crop mode when resizing. 'center' crops to fit, 'disabled' stretches to fit.

use_tiled_encode.tooltip: Enable tiled VAE encoding for large resolutions/long videos to reduce memory usage.

tile_size.tooltip: Spatial tile size for tiled encoding. Only used when use_tiled_encode is enabled.

tile_overlap.tooltip: Overlap between tiles for tiled encoding. Only used when use_tiled_encode is enabled.

use_streaming.tooltip: Off (default): encode the whole clip as one IC-LoRA guide. On: re-encode one fresh guide per LTXVTiledFusionSampler temporal window and write the plan the sampler reads. Set tile_frames on this node and the sampler to the same value (97 for LTX).

tile_frames.tooltip: Window length in pixel frames, used only when use_streaming is on. Snapped to 8n+1. Must match LTXVTiledFusionSampler. Ignored when use_streaming is off.

LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide.name: LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide
LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide.description: Adds one or more conditioning frames starting at the specified frame index. Supports both single images and multi-frame videos. The latent_downscale_factor resizes input to a fraction of the target size (1 = original, 2 = half, 3 = third, etc.) for IC-LoRA on small grids. For LTXVTiledFusionSampler temporal windows, turn on use_streaming and set tile_frames to the same 8n+1 value as the sampler (97 for LTX).

LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly.name: LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly
LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly.description: Loads a LoRA model and extracts the latent_downscale_factor from the safetensors metadata.

positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning from the IC-LoRA guide node. Must carry keyframe_idxs / guide_attention_entries so each tile can be cropped to the LoRA's trained window.

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning from the IC-LoRA guide node.

latents.tooltip: The latent RETURNED BY the IC-LoRA guide node (it carries appended guide frames plus the noise mask). A bare empty video latent will not work.

sigmas.tooltip: Denoise schedule. Must be descending and end at 0. Fusion walks this list one step at a time.

sampler.tooltip: From KSamplerSelect (same type as SamplerCustomAdvanced). Discrete step samplers only: euler, euler_ancestral, heun, dpm_2, … History methods (DPM++ 2M, LMS) lose their multi-step memory because fusion owns the loop. Adaptive samplers cannot fuse. Ancestral methods add independent noise per tile and can seam.

seed.tooltip: Seed for the single shared noise field across all tiles.

cfg.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance scale. Distilled models typically use 1.0.

tile_width.tooltip: Tile width in pixels, multiple of 32. Set this to the IC-LoRA's trained spatial window. Tiles smaller than the trained window make every tile see content at the wrong scale.

tile_height.tooltip: Tile height in pixels, multiple of 32. Match tile_width to the IC-LoRA's trained spatial window.

overlap_frac.tooltip: Fraction of each tile overlapping its neighbor. Stay at 0.5 or above: below that a periodic grid appears on structured content.

blend_var.tooltip: Variance of the Gaussian blend weights in the overlaps. Leave at 0.05 unless you are measuring seams.

grid_cycle.tooltip: Cycle shifted tile grids across steps. 1 = fixed grid (cheapest), 4 = thorough. Spatial only: cycling the temporal grid slides content in time.

tile_frames.tooltip: Temporal window in pixel frames (97 for LTX). 0 = one extent. Other values are snapped to 8n+1. >0 needs LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide with use_streaming on and the SAME tile_frames: that re-encodes a fresh guide per window and writes the plan this sampler reads. A whole-clip guide cannot be sliced, and windowing is disabled if the plan is missing.

vae.tooltip: Used to read the model's temporal and spatial downscale factors. If omitted, they are taken from the diffusion model (LTX defaults: 8 frames and 32 pixels per latent cell).

canvas_device.tooltip: Where to keep the full-canvas tensors and cached tile latents/noise/masks. auto = GPU if there is enough free memory, otherwise CPU. Processed conds stay on the GPU.
